|lore=Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
|game_text=You may activate 1 extra Force each turn if Luke is not at a Tatooine site. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition &lt; 3.
|errata_history=[[Decipher]] published replacement game text for [[Luke Skywalker]] in [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 89. It changes the activation condition from being present at a non-Tatooine location to not being at a Tatooine site, extends the piloting bonus from a starship to anything he pilots, and replaces “On Red 5” with “When piloting Red 5”. The English [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|Reflections foil]] physically prints this revised text.<ref name="decipher-1998">[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 1–2 and 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="wording-faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|English Reflections foil]] and [[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Reflections III foil]].</ref>

The later digital face and high-resolution reconstruction use different wording: “While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1.” The official [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1|PC Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]] (July 2007), Appendix A, uses this wording. Its introduction identifies the book as the official rulebook replacing previous rulebooks and rulings. It is not the literal text published in the November 1998 Glossary. The Card Text section retains that Decipher text.<ref name="pc-2007">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1], [[Players Committee]] (July 2007), introduction, PDF p. 7 (printed p. vi), and Appendix A, PDF p. 106, Luke Skywalker. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki copy: [[Media:AR-version-1-7-1.pdf]].</ref>

The PC also publishes this wording on a printable Luke slip in its 2017 ''Decipher Errata'' document, whose cover gives an official-text cutoff of 1 June 2017.<ref name="pc-2017-slip">[[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Decipher Errata]], [[Players Committee]] (2017), cover and Luke Skywalker slip, PDF p. 18.</ref>

The contemporary PC download catalog lists the rulebook as added on 12 July 2007 and legal from 29 July 2007.<ref name="pc-2007-catalog">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=3 Downloads: Resources], [[Players Committee]], “Advanced Rulebook — Legal July 29th 2007”, added 12 July 2007. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024151320/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=3 Internet Archive].</ref>
